scope: own fp32 ONNX export of the official streaming encoder; parity + end-to-end token gate; not chunked-state export, not fp16, not library integration
gate_rationale: Cross-process bit-exactness is not a property of this stack: the torch fp32 encoder itself does not reproduce its hidden-state digest across processes (oneDNN thread scheduling), so the gate is explicit fp32 tolerances (allclose atol/rtol 1e-4, cosine >= 0.999999; measured max abs 4.26e-5) plus exact official token/text equality. Digests remain recorded as identity evidence, not as the gate.

tokens.text: And so, my fellow Americans, ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your country.

limits: Whole-utterance encoder path; the streaming chunked-state graph (conv/window carries) is the next export step and is not covered by this gate.
Single fixture (JFK); CPU execution provider only; no memory or speed measurement.
